spec: §8.2-§8.4 + §14 — versioned self-describing backup format: descriptor, QR payload, nodeid file, restore round-trip, descriptor-absent fallback, fail-closed refusals
description: The 4-byte descriptor (version 0x01 || curve 0x01 = ed25519+x25519 dual || derivation 0x01 = SLIP-0010 m/111'/0'/{0',1'} || encoding 0x01 = BIP-39 English 12 words, 0x02 = 24 words); the CompactSeedQR-style project QR payload (descriptor || raw entropy, 20B at 12 words / 36B at 24); the section 13 identity-dir file bodies (mnemonic file = words + trailing newline, nodeid = 34B 0xed01 record, descriptor = 4B, keyset = 64B). Round-trip: mnemonic -> descriptor -> seed -> keyset -> restore -> identical NodeId. A restore with NO descriptor assumes the v1 defaults (encoding byte taken from the parsed word count). Unknown descriptor fields, bad lengths and contradictory QR payloads fail closed. Tokens are the Rust Debug names of the error variants.
provenance: canonical-12 harvested from backup.rs::backup_format_kat (--nocapture); canonical-24 and all negatives generated through the public API for this freeze; expect tokens recorded at generation time.
